requested_outcome: Repair both homepage availability rails and Professor verified answers, retain interactive data-backed charts, run the complete QQQAAA family, publish one frozen candidate and verify it in production.
authorization_boundary: Code, tests, one production publication and production verification are authorized. Do not alter supplier data, permissions, secrets, DNS or unrelated user files.

lesson_bundle.reason: A resumed long-running VII task must not inherit unverified completion claims.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Every requested outcome remains pending until exact evidence exists.

lesson_bundle.reason: The visible error must be translated into a complete operational result.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Verify the homepage and Professor at their public destinations.

lesson_bundle.reason: Both fixes affect shared production paths and require regression evidence.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Run targeted tests, full QQQAAA, and post-release production checks.

lesson_bundle.reason: The user explicitly requires publication without losing prior work.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Freeze source and tree, keep rollback identity, deploy once, then verify HTTP and live behavior.

lesson_bundle.reason: Professor and its charts are daily admin operations, not decorative UI.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Answers must use verified data, expose freshness, survive reload, and keep permissions and quotas.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The homepage rails still end in the retry error shown in the screenshot.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Restore the bounded cache-bypassing GET retry and add a public two-rail audit gate.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Both public rail containers finish without terminal error and contain verified cards.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Professor still returns a generic failure for a simple calls question.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Make data-source access selective so a Biz-only question cannot be failed by unrelated V tables.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The exact public question returns a numeric or explicitly unavailable verified Biz result, not a generic error.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Charts look interactive but use invented or stale values.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Render charts only from the returned answer metrics and display coverage and saved time.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Public chart values match the answer payload and view buttons switch visible data.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A new release breaks another world or mobile state.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Run QQQAAA with the new Professor and rail regression tests included.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: All mandatory suites pass on the frozen candidate and public matrix passes after release.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Publication is claimed from code or build evidence only.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Verify the exact deployed version in the public homepage and authenticated admin.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Record version, deployment, source, tree, rollback, HTTP 200 and live UI evidence.

midpoint_gate.trigger: After root-cause fixes and targeted tests, before freezing the release candidate.
checks: Reproduce the old Professor failure in production
Prove Biz-only source isolation in a unit test
Prove both rails with the public audit

attack_questions: Can either rail still finish in a terminal error after reload?
Can a Biz-only question still touch V event or booking tables?
Do the chart values come only from the returned verified answer?
Did the exact deployed artifact pass the affected family after publication?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Live homepage rail state and authenticated live Professor response after publication.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: QQQAAA report, targeted regression tests and post-release route matrix.

effectiveness.baseline: Public v708 reproduced a generic Professor failure and the supplied screenshot captured terminal errors in both homepage availability rails.
effectiveness.target: One frozen publication whose homepage rails and exact Professor question work publicly without regressing the QQQAAA family.
